abilities.name: stall
abilities.effect: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.

abilities.name: prankster
abilities.effect: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.

hoenn.flavorText: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

updated-johto.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

original-unova.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

updated-unova.flavorText: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

kalos.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Sableye digs the ground with sharpened claws to find rocks that it eats. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the Pokémon’s body surface.

original-alola.flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believed that Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.

updated-alola.flavorText: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

swsh.flavorText: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.
